messages.subject: Repeated crashing with function occu
parts:
Hi,
I've been doing some occupancy modeling with unmarked and for a while I was successfully producing some occupancy estimates for single species for a single season. I wanted to create a loop to generate estimates from multiple species over multiple seasons so I wrote a nested for loop with 'occu' at its heart but it crashed when I tried to run it. Now even when I go back and try to run a simple occupancy model (no loops or anything) R crashes. I've tried updating R as well as uninstalling and reinstalling unmarked but nothing's worked. 
Does anyone have any suggestions?
Thanks!
